brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights marked the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women on November 25, coinciding with the launch of the 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence. The organization stated that Palestinian women face devastating consequences from what it characterizes as Israeli policies of genocide and erasure, sustaining immeasurable losses in lives and rights.

The Centre linked the observance to broader accountability concerns, asserting that protection for Palestinian women requires ending the conditions it describes as driving their vulnerability. The statement framed justice and accountability as prerequisites for meaningful safety and protection.
dek: Today, 25 November, marks the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women and the launch of the 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence. This occasion comes as Palestinian women continue to bear the devastating consequences of Israel’s policies of genocide and erasure, paying an immeasurable price in terms of their lives, rights…
title: Palestinian Centre for Human Rights marks violence awareness day amid genocide claims
